name: San Cristóbal de Segovia (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of white, blue and white with the blue of double width, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Cristóbal de Segovia (four wavy fesses on blue within a bordure of flax plants).
history: San Cristóbal de Segovia adopted its arms and flag officially on 23 January 2009, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 10 March 2009; the flag is a square cloth of proportion 1:1 divided horizontally into three stripes, the central blue of double width and the outer ones white, with the municipal arms in its colours superimposed at the centre.
